method: ENTIRELY from AMH across four pages, read under subscription and PARAPHRASED: no passage reproduced, no source_text stored, every claim carries its page's locator and the verdict licensed_source_not_quoted, so NOTHING here is machine re-checkable. A targeted search of RACGP's open AJGP returned no current Australian article on pulmonary arterial hypertension; that absence is recorded rather than filled with an older or overseas source. PAH is a specialist-managed condition and this guideline is written as a PRIMARY-CARE SAFETY DOCUMENT -- what must not be co-prescribed, what must be monitored -- not as a treatment algorithm. The prostacyclins (epoprostenol, iloprost, selexipag), tadalafil, ambrisentan, bosentan and macitentan monographs were NOT retrieved and carry no doses here.
